text: I collected these works because my eye kept returning to them. I found myself looking for patterns and trying to understand the feeling in each image. Some seemed joyous; others felt angry. That range kept me looking. I connected with scrimshaw for a similar reason: I saw a related visual character and emotional range in the work, and both artists were publishing on Nifty Ink during the same period. This gallery brings those works together and invites you to spend time looking for your own connections.
